MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The assorted heat shrink tubing complements my spade terminals by helping insulate connections across different repair jobs.",
    "The waterproof crimp connector assortment fits my electrical repair interests and adds a useful option alongside the terminals I already bought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The large cable sleeve, exact-size screws, cutting wheels and powered valve each require a specific project or tool need that my purchases do not establish.",
    "Ten tubes of super glue exceed my current needs, while zero clearance tape serves a different purpose from my general repair tapes. The COVID test does not connect to my current repair shopping.",
    "Solder seal connectors are relevant, but I would choose the crimp assortment now rather than buy two overlapping connector kits."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been taken as interest in specialized workshop equipment, even when I have no matching task.",
    "Shared words such as tape, adhesive or plumbing seem to carry too much weight when the actual use differs from what I bought."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about whether a supply complements something I already own, as insulation does for my electrical terminals.",
    "Exact dimensions, required tools and pack quantities matter to whether I can use an item now; broad repair relevance is not enough.",
    "My electrical terminal purchase was several years ago, so it suggests a possible interest rather than proof of an active wiring project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests, but often stretched them into specialized purchases without a clear current use."
}
